articles.title: Bitcoin weathers September storm as rate hikes and Clarity act setback test bulls
articles.snippet: Bitcoin is down just 1.5% in its historically weakest month and remains on track for its first quarterly gain in a year, despite rising rates, surging oil and a stronger dollar.

articles.title: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in 3 months. Other demand signals look weak, too.
articles.snippet: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in three months, while broader demand signals remain weak.

articles.title: Ether and XRP ETFs post outflows as crypto majors move higher
articles.snippet: Ether funds shed money for a third straight session even as the token rose, while every major gained and zcash extended its run.

articles.title: World launches self-custodial ‘super app’ World Money
articles.snippet: World Money is rolling out across more than 150 countries, combining stablecoin payments, digital asset rewards and trading in a self-custodial app.

articles.title: North Korea drives onchain malware surge, CoinEx shuts: Asia Express
articles.snippet: North Korea and Iran account for the majority of onchain malware, while Malaysia has been named among the most crypto curious Islamic nations.
